sets.title: Prefix Meanings
sets.description: Identify what each prefix means and sort verbs by prefix
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите значение приставки и распределите глаголы по группам

items.prompt: Какую приставку нужно добавить, чтобы сказать 'to enter' (move into)?
items.hint: Think about moving INTO a space.
items.explanation: The prefix в- means 'into': входить = to enter (go into).

items.prompt: Она _____ из дома рано утром. (She left the house early in the morning.)
items.promptEnglish: She went out of the house early in the morning.
items.explanation: Вышла (вы- + шла) = went out. The prefix вы- indicates movement outward.

items.promptEnglish: What does пере- mean in переписать (to rewrite)?
items.hint: If you писать something again, you пере-писать it.
items.explanation: Пере- often means 're-' or 'across'. Переписать = to rewrite (write again).

items.prompt: Друг _____ ко мне в гости. (My friend arrived to visit me.)
items.promptEnglish: My friend came (arrived) to visit me.
items.explanation: Пришёл (при- + шёл) = arrived, came. При- signals arrival at a destination.

items.promptEnglish: What does у- signal in уходить?
items.hint: When someone уходит, they leave and don't come back soon.
items.explanation: У- means 'away (for good)': уходить = to leave, go away. The departure is typically final or long-term.

items.prompt: Поезд медленно _____ к платформе. (The train slowly approached the platform.)
items.promptEnglish: The train slowly approached the platform.
items.explanation: Подошёл (под- + шёл) = approached. Под- indicates moving closer to something.

items.prompt: Мы _____ через весь город пешком. (We walked through the entire city on foot.)
items.promptEnglish: We walked through the entire city on foot.
items.explanation: Прошли (про- + шли) = walked through. Про- means movement through or past something.

items.prompt: Автобус _____ от остановки. (The bus pulled away from the stop.)
items.promptEnglish: The bus moved away from the stop.
items.explanation: Отошёл (от- + шёл) = moved away. От- indicates distancing from a point.

items.prompt: Ребёнок наконец _____. (The child finally fell asleep.)
items.hint: За- can signal the beginning of an action.
items.explanation: Заснул (за- + снул) = fell asleep. За- here marks the onset of sleep.

items.prompt: Они _____ дорогу на зелёный свет. (They crossed the road on the green light.)
items.promptEnglish: They crossed the road on the green light.
items.explanation: Перешли (пере- + шли) = crossed. Пере- here means 'across' from one side to the other.

sets.title: Prefix Pairs
sets.description: Distinguish between similar prefixed verbs and fill in the correct form
sets.descriptionRussian: Различите глаголы с похожими приставками и вставьте правильную форму

minimalPairs.context: Он _____ в комнату и закрыл дверь. (He entered the room.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: He went INTO the room and closed the door.
minimalPairs.explanation: Вошёл (в- = into) means 'entered'. Вышел (вы- = out) would mean 'exited'.

minimalPairs.context: Она _____ из офиса на обед. (She left the office for lunch.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: She went OUT of the office for lunch.
minimalPairs.explanation: Вышла (вы- = out) means 'went out'. She left the office, moving outward.

minimalPairs.context: Гости наконец _____! (The guests have finally arrived!)
minimalPairs.explanation: Пришли (при- = arrival) means 'arrived'. Ушли (у- = away) would mean they left.

minimalPairs.context: Все _____, и в доме стало тихо. (Everyone left, and the house became quiet.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Everyone went away, and the house became quiet.
minimalPairs.explanation: Ушли (у- = away) means 'left/departed'. The house is now empty and quiet.

minimalPairs.context: Лодка медленно _____ к берегу. (The boat slowly approached the shore.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The boat slowly moved TOWARD the shore.
minimalPairs.explanation: Подошла (под- = approach) means 'approached'. Отошла (от- = away from) would mean 'moved away'.

minimalPairs.context: Корабль _____ от причала. (The ship moved away from the pier.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The ship moved AWAY FROM the pier.
minimalPairs.explanation: Отошёл (от- = away from) means 'moved away from'. The ship is leaving the pier.

minimalPairs.context: Мы _____ через парк и вышли к реке. (We walked through the park.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: We passed THROUGH the park and came out at the river.
minimalPairs.explanation: Прошли (про- = through) means 'walked through'. Перешли (пере- = across) would mean 'crossed'.

minimalPairs.context: Дети _____ улицу по пешеходному переходу. (The children crossed the street.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: The children crossed the street at the crosswalk.
minimalPairs.explanation: Перешли (пере- = across) means 'crossed'. They went from one side to the other.

blanks: Кот _____ в дом через окно. (The cat came into the house through the window.)
Студент _____ из аудитории, забыв тетрадь. (The student went out of the lecture hall, forgetting his notebook.)
Такси _____ к подъезду. (The taxi pulled up to the entrance.)
Поезд _____ от станции. (The train departed from the station.)
Мы _____ все документы заново. (We rewrote all the documents.)
Соседи _____ из этого дома в прошлом месяце. (The neighbors moved away from this house last month.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Selecting the correct prefix based on direction of movement or action
hints: В- = into. The cat went in through the window.
Вы- = out. He left the room.
Под- = approach. The taxi came closer to the building.
От- = away from. The train moved away from a fixed point.
Пере- = re-/again. They wrote the documents again.
У- = away (departure). They left for good.
explanations: Влез (в- = into): the cat climbed INTO the house.
Вышел (вы- = out): the student went OUT of the lecture hall.
Подъехало (под- = approach): the taxi drove up TO the entrance.
Отошёл (от- = away from): the train moved AWAY FROM the station.
Переписали (пере- = re-): they wrote the documents AGAIN from scratch.
Уехали (у- = away): the neighbors left/moved away permanently.

sets.title: Change the Prefix
sets.description: Transform sentences by changing the prefix to change the meaning
sets.descriptionRussian: Измените предложения, заменив приставку и изменив смысл

errorCorrection.sentence: Он вышел в комнату и сел за стол.
errorCorrection.hint: Moving INTO a room requires в- (into), not вы- (out).
errorCorrection.explanation: Вошёл в комнату (entered the room). Вышел means 'exited', which contradicts sitting down inside.

errorCorrection.hint: Moving AWAY FROM a stop uses от- (away from), not при- (arrival).
errorCorrection.explanation: Отъехал от остановки (pulled away from the stop). Приехал means 'arrived', not 'departed'.

errorCorrection.hint: Crossing a street uses пере- (across), not про- (through).
errorCorrection.explanation: Переходила улицу (was crossing the street). Про- means passing through, not crossing to the other side.

errorCorrection.hint: Running TOWARD someone uses под- (approach), not от- (away).
errorCorrection.explanation: Подбежал к маме (ran up to mom). Отбежал means 'ran away from'.

errorCorrection.sentence: Текст был плохой, поэтому я его прописал заново.
errorCorrection.hint: Doing something AGAIN uses пере- (re-), not про-.
errorCorrection.explanation: Переписал (rewrote). Пере- means 'again/re-'. Про- would mean writing through to the end.

sets.title: Build and Translate
sets.description: Build sentences from words and translate sentences using the correct prefix
sets.descriptionRussian: Составьте предложения из слов и переведите, используя правильную приставку

translation.english: The cat ran into the house.
translation.hint: В- = into. Use в- + бежать for 'ran into'.

translation.english: She took the books out of the bag.
translation.hint: Вы- = out. Moving objects out of a container.

translation.english: The train arrived at the station.
translation.hint: При- = arrival. The train reached its destination.

translation.english: He left early and did not say goodbye.
translation.answer: Он ушёл рано и не попрощался.
acceptableVariants: Он рано ушёл и не попрощался.
translation.hint: У- = away (departure). He departed without saying goodbye.

translation.english: I need to rewrite this essay.
The bus drove past our stop without stopping.
translation.answer: Автобус проехал мимо нашей остановки без остановки.
acceptableVariants: Автобус проехал нашу остановку, не остановившись.
translation.hint: Про- = through/past. The bus went right past.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: A comprehensive review of all prefix meanings

items.prompt: Лиса _____ в нору. (The fox ran into its den.)
items.promptEnglish: The fox ran into its burrow.
items.hint: За- can mean 'behind' or 'into (a sheltered space)'.
items.explanation: Забежала в нору (ran into the burrow). За- here means going into/behind something.

items.prompt: Самолёт _____ через облака. (The plane flew through the clouds.)
items.promptEnglish: The plane passed through the clouds.
items.explanation: Пролетел через облака (flew through the clouds). Про- signals passing through something.

items.prompt: Все птицы _____ на юг. (All the birds flew away south.)
items.promptEnglish: All the birds flew away to the south.
items.explanation: Улетели на юг (flew away south). У- indicates departure for a long time.

items.prompt: Ласточки _____ весной. (The swallows arrive in spring.)
items.explanation: Прилетают (при- = arrival): the swallows arrive, they come to this place.

items.prompt: Река _____ через весь город. (The river flows through the entire city.)
items.promptEnglish: The river passes through the whole city.
items.explanation: Проходит через город (passes through the city). Про- for movement through the entire length.

items.prompt: Не стой на дороге, _____! (Don't stand in the road, move away!)
items.promptEnglish: Don't stand in the road, step aside!
items.explanation: Отойди (от- = away from): move away from the dangerous spot.

items.prompt: Мы _____ границу рано утром. (We crossed the border early in the morning.)
items.promptEnglish: We crossed the border early in the morning.
items.hint: Пере- means 'across' from one side to the other.
items.explanation: Перешли границу (crossed the border). Пере- indicates crossing from one side to the other.

items.prompt: Он _____ за угол и исчез. (He went behind the corner and disappeared.)
items.promptEnglish: He went behind the corner and disappeared.
items.explanation: Зашёл за угол (went behind the corner). За- indicates going behind or around something.

items.prompt: Ребёнок _____ к маме и обнял её. (The child walked up to mom and hugged her.)
items.promptEnglish: The child walked up to mom and hugged her.
items.explanation: Подошёл к маме (walked up to mom). Под- signals approaching someone.

patternRecognition.question: What do all four verbs share?
options: They all contain prefix в- meaning 'into'
patternRecognition.answer: They all contain prefix в- meaning 'into'
patternRecognition.explanation: All four use в- (into): enter on foot, carry in, run in, fly in. The base verb changes, but the direction stays the same.

patternRecognition.question: What meaning do these verbs share?
patternRecognition.explanation: All use у- (away): leave on foot, carry away, drive away, fly away. У- consistently signals leaving for an extended or permanent time.

patternRecognition.question: What does пере- add to each verb?
patternRecognition.explanation: Пере- here means 're-/again': rewrite, re-read, redo, re-watch. One of the most productive meanings of пере-.

patternRecognition.question: What does за- signal in these verbs?
patternRecognition.explanation: За- here marks the onset: burst into tears, burst out laughing, start singing, fall asleep. This is the 'inchoative' за-.
